payload.recallText: The narrator was either related to, or very close to, the Kennedy's.  Every summer, her four aunts would take her and her sister to Hyannis on vacation.  The aunts loved to spy on the Kennedy's from the beach.  One summer, the girls were unsupervised in the water and found an old boat.  They got in and were swept out to open water.  While they aunts were helpless, two of the Kennedy's saved the girls on their powerboat.
